File:Senator Mark Warner with Chilean Mi.description: Senator Mark Warner (D-Va.) visited NASA Langley to congratulate NASA Engineering and Safety Center engineers who worked as a team to help the Chilean Navy design a better capsule to rescue 33 trapped miners in October. From left to right are Dan Murri, Joel Levine, Kenny Elliott, Bill Prosser, Clint Cragg, Sen. Warner, Dave Schuster, Norm Knight, Ivatury Raju. Warner congratulated the group on their hard work and said it reflected some of the best this country has to offer.
